prompt: Can you write a short yet concise essay on the 1905 bloody sunday. The essay should inform the reader about the causes, effects and role of bloody sunday.
judge_reasoning: All candidates attempt the requested causes/effects/role structure for Bloody Sunday, but correctness and specificity vary. Candidate 1 gives the most reliable, well-aligned narrative with no major historical misattributions and appropriate linkage to the 1905 revolution and the October Manifesto. Candidate 3 is generally accurate but includes somewhat overstated/loose connections (e.g., to 1917) and less precise attribution of the organizers and political goals. Candidate 2 and especially Candidate 4 contain more questionable or clearly incorrect specifics (Candidate 4 incorrectly invokes the Saint Petersburg Soviet and a named general), lowering factual reliability.
